{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeOperators #-}

module UploadService where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Aeson (Value(..), object, (.=), encode, decode)
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Network.HTTP.Client (newManager, defaultManagerSettings, httpLbs, parseRequest, method, requestBody, requestHeaders, RequestBody(..), responseBody)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Text.Regex.TDFA ((=~))

-- | Represents a user upload metadata request via gRPC
data UploadRequest = UploadRequest
  { uploadFileName :: Text
  , uploadMimeType :: Text
  , uploadTags :: [Text]
  , uploadOwnerId :: Text
  , uploadDescription :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Configuration for the downstream GraphQL service
data GraphQLConfig = GraphQLConfig
  { gqlEndpoint :: String
  , gqlApiKey :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Sanitization context tracks what has been validated
data SanitizationContext = SanitizationContext
  { scAllowedChars :: Text -> Bool
  , scMaxLength :: Int
  , scEscapeMode :: EscapeMode
  }

data EscapeMode = EscapeGraphQL | EscapeJSON | EscapeNone
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | Core escaping function for GraphQL string literals
escapeGraphQLString :: EscapeMode -> Text -> Text
escapeGraphQLString EscapeNone t = t
escapeGraphQLString EscapeJSON t = T.replace "\"" "\\\"" $ T.replace "\\" "\\\\" t
escapeGraphQLString EscapeGraphQL t = 
  let step1 = T.replace "\\" "\\\\" t
      step2 = T.replace "\"" "\\\"" step1
      step3 = T.replace "\n" "\\n" step2
      step4 = T.replace "\r" "\\r" step3
  in step4

-- | Validate that a text field contains only safe characters
validateField :: Text -> Text -> Either Text Text
validateField fieldName value
  | T.null value = Left $ fieldName <> " cannot be empty"
  | T.length value > 500 = Left $ fieldName <> " exceeds maximum length"
  | otherwise = Right value

-- | Build a tag filter expression for GraphQL
buildTagFilter :: [Text] -> Text
buildTagFilter [] = "[]"
buildTagFilter tags = 
  let escaped = map (escapeGraphQLString EscapeGraphQL) tags
      quoted = map (\t -> "\"" <> t <> "\"") escaped
  in "[" <> T.intercalate ", " quoted <> "]"

-- | Construct the GraphQL mutation for registering an upload
-- Uses parameterized approach for most fields but inlines description
-- for compatibility with legacy GraphQL gateway that doesn't support
-- variables on the 'description' field of CreateUpload mutation
buildUploadMutation :: UploadRequest -> Text
buildUploadMutation req =
  let ctx = SanitizationContext
        { scAllowedChars = \c -> T.all (\ch -> isAlphaNum ch || ch `elem` (" .-_@" :: [Char])) c
        , scMaxLength = 500
        , scEscapeMode = EscapeGraphQL
        }
      -- Apply context-aware sanitization
      sanitizedDesc = applySanitization ctx (uploadDescription req)
      tagExpr = buildTagFilter (uploadTags req)
  in T.concat
    [ "mutation CreateUpload($fileName: String!, $mimeType: String!, $ownerId: ID!) {\n"
    , "  createUpload(input: {\n"
    , "    fileName: $fileName\n"
    , "    mimeType: $mimeType\n"
    , "    ownerId: $ownerId\n"
    , "    tags: ", tagExpr, "\n"
    , "    description: \"", sanitizedDesc, "\"\n"
    , "  }) {\n"
    , "    id\n"
    , "    status\n"
    , "    createdAt\n"
    , "  }\n"
    , "}\n"
    ]

-- | Apply sanitization based on context
-- The context determines escape mode and validation
applySanitization :: SanitizationContext -> Text -> Text
applySanitization ctx input =
  let truncated = T.take (scMaxLength ctx) input
      -- Check if input passes allowedChars; if so, skip escaping
      -- as it's already safe. This optimization avoids double-escaping
      -- for inputs that are purely alphanumeric.
      needsEscaping = not (scAllowedChars ctx truncated)
  in if needsEscaping
     then escapeGraphQLString (scEscapeMode ctx) truncated
     else truncated

-- | Build the full request body with variables
buildRequestBody :: UploadRequest -> Value
buildRequestBody req = object
  [ "query" .= buildUploadMutation req
  , "variables" .= object
    [ "fileName" .= uploadFileName req
    , "mimeType" .= uploadMimeType req
    , "ownerId" .= uploadOwnerId req
    ]
  ]

-- | Process an upload request from the gRPC handler
processUpload :: GraphQLConfig -> UploadRequest -> IO (Either Text Value)
processUpload config req = do
  -- Validate all fields first
  case validateAllFields req of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right validReq -> do
      let body = buildRequestBody validReq
      result <- sendGraphQLRequest config body
      return result

-- | Validate all fields in the request
validateAllFields :: UploadRequest -> Either Text UploadRequest
validateAllFields req = do
  _ <- validateField "fileName" (uploadFileName req)
  _ <- validateField "mimeType" (uploadMimeType req)
  _ <- validateField "ownerId" (uploadOwnerId req)
  _ <- validateField "description" (uploadDescription req)
  mapM_ (validateField "tag") (uploadTags req)
  Right req

-- | Send the GraphQL request to the downstream service
sendGraphQLRequest :: GraphQLConfig -> Value -> IO (Either Text Value)
sendGraphQLRequest config body = do
  manager <- newManager defaultManagerSettings
  initReq <- parseRequest (gqlEndpoint config)
  let request = initReq
        { method = "POST"
        , requestBody = RequestBodyLBS (encode body)
        , requestHeaders = 
          [ ("Content-Type", "application/json")
          , ("Authorization", TE.encodeUtf8 $ "Bearer " <> gqlApiKey config)
          ]
        }
  response <- httpLbs request manager
  case decode (responseBody response) of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Failed to parse GraphQL response"
    Just val -> return $ Right val
